title: GM 1.4 turbo (Cruze, Sonic, Trax, Encore): rough idle and P0171 from a cracked PCV diaphragm in the cam cover (10 yr / 120k)
summary: GM Special Coverage N202299080: the PCV pressure regulator diaphragm built into the camshaft cover can crack and draw in unmetered air, causing rough idle (especially at idle), a check engine light and P0171 or other airflow codes. A new cam cover is covered for 10 years / 120,000 miles; the bulletin includes a quick noise-and-tissue test.

specs.name: Coverage
specs.value: 10 years or 120,000 miles (193,000 km) from original in-service date, regardless of ownership

specs.name: DTC
specs.value: P0171 Fuel Trim System Lean, or other airflow-related codes

specs.name: Labor
specs.value: 0.4 hr Cruze / 0.6 hr Trax (other models per bulletin); diagnosis only 0.1-0.5 hr

steps.text: A P0171 or airflow-code diagnosis may point to the PCV system as a source of extra air.
Remove the engine cover. Make sure the dipstick is fully seated and the oil fill cap is tight.
Engine running, listen at the PCV valve on the cam cover. If it's making noise, pull the dipstick and see if the noise gets quieter or stops, then reinsert it.
Hold a piece of tissue at the PCV vent on the front of the valve. If the tissue is pulled against it and held, there's vacuum there.
Noise plus vacuum at the vent: replace the camshaft cover. No noise or no vacuum leak: the special coverage doesn't apply. Only a leaking PCV valve is covered, not cam cover oil leaks.

sources.title: Special Coverage Adjustment N202299080: Camshaft Cover Replacement
